game.core.rules.readable.title: Route Travel
game.core.rules.readable.summary: Travel follows a known route with a declared pace, calculates its duration, schedules exposure, and records arrival through the active travel mechanics.

blocks.heading: Travel a known route
items: Choose a known route and a supported travel pace.
Calculate duration and any scheduled exposure from the route's recorded distance and conditions.
Execute the trip and record arrival only after its required progress is complete.

examples.title: Changing pace
examples.body: Selecting a different supported pace changes the calculated duration through the travel mechanic; the browser does not recalculate it independently.

citations.locator: Gameplay Toolbox > Travel Pace, PDF p. 192
